sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“99%隐形”。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Every morning, I wake up, roll over, pick up my phone, and check Twitter.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，我醒来、翻身、拿起手机，然后刷推特。

sentences.en: I'm not proud of this.
sentences.zh: 我并不为此感到骄傲。

sentences.en: It's just the way it is.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: Twitter always struck me as the social media platform that was the most like broadcasting.
sentences.zh: 推特给我的感觉一直是那个最像广播的社交媒体平台。

sentences.en: It's an ongoing global conversation you can jump in to get a sense of what's going on in the world, and jump out.
sentences.zh: 它是一个你可以随时加入以了解世界动态、又可以随时退出的持续进行的全球对话。

sentences.en: It's a lot like scanning through a radio dial, but it's mainly comprised of people you know and the people they know,
sentences.zh: 它很像在收音机刻度盘上搜台，但它主要由你认识的人和他们认识的人组成，

sentences.en: telling you about their day, reacting to shocking news, making jokes, and sending around links.
sentences.zh: 向你讲述他们的日常、对震惊事件的反应、开玩笑以及转发各种链接。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars, by the way, if you haven't heard me say that before.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，如果你以前没听过我说的话，我的推特账号是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: And sometimes I tweet at Truffleman.
sentences.zh: 有时我也会给松露人发推。

sentences.en: Because this producer's name is Avery Truffleman.
sentences.zh: 因为这位制作人的名字叫埃弗里·松露人。

sentences.en: But if you want to find out about the show in general, there's a hashtag for it.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想了解这个节目的总体情况，有一个专门的标签。

sentences.en: It's hashtag 99PI.
sentences.zh: 就是 99PI 标签。

sentences.en: The hashtag, of course, is comprised of two vertical lines intersecting two horizontal lines that looks like a tic-tac-toe board.
sentences.zh: 这个标签当然是由两条垂直线与两条水平线相交组成，看起来像个井字棋盘。

sentences.en: In the current digital world, the hashtag identifies movements, events, happenings, brands, topics of all kinds.
sentences.zh: 在当今的数字世界中，话题标签识别着各种运动、事件、发生的事情、品牌和主题。

sentences.en: Hashtags help people gather.
sentences.zh: 标签帮助人们聚集在一起。

sentences.en: That's incredible power to give to, like, individuals.
sentences.zh: 赋予个人这种力量真是不可思议。

sentences.en: And as a character, I mean, awesome.
sentences.zh: 而作为一个角色，我的意思是，太棒了。

sentences.en: It's got, like, this little typographic superhero story now.
sentences.zh: 它现在就像是一个带有这种排版色彩的小小超级英雄故事。

sentences.en: And this superhero story stars Chris Messina.
sentences.zh: 而这个超级英雄故事的主角是克里斯·梅西纳。

sentences.en: I'm Chris Messina, the inventor of the hashtag.
sentences.zh: 我是克里斯·梅西纳，标签的发明者。

sentences.en: I'm a designer and translator.
sentences.zh: 我是一名设计师和翻译。

sentences.en: Translator?
sentences.zh: 翻译？

sentences.en: Of human culture.
sentences.zh: 人类文化的翻译。

sentences.en: That's probably a little bit bloated.
sentences.zh: 这话说得可能有点夸张了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know what I do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: Chris was the first one to use a hashtag on Twitter, before it was even called a hashtag.
sentences.zh: 克里斯是推特上第一个使用标签的人，当时它甚至还不叫标签。

sentences.en: Back in August of 2007, when he was going to an event called Bar Camp.
sentences.zh: 早在2007年8月，当他要去参加一个名为 Bar Camp 的活动时。

sentences.en: It's a nerdy thing.
sentences.zh: 那是个很极客的事情。

sentences.en: It's a totally nerdy thing.
sentences.zh: 完全是一个极客的事情。

sentences.en: It's an event that you go to that's completely unstructured and unplanned, and the participants figure it out.
sentences.zh: 这是一个你去的完全没有结构和计划的活动，由参与者自己来琢磨。

sentences.en: So the participants needed a way of organizing, which led Chris to tweet the very first hashtag, even though at that point it was just a pound sign.
sentences.zh: 因此，参与者需要一种组织方式，这促使克里斯发出了第一个标签，尽管当时它只是一个井号。

sentences.en: How do you guys feel about using pound Bar Camp for groups?
sentences.zh: 大家觉得用 pound Bar Camp 来作为群组代号怎么样？

sentences.en: Putting a pound sign in front of the word Bar Camp helps the other people at Bar Camp pick out the word Bar Camp in their Twitter stream,
sentences.zh: 在 Bar Camp 这个词前面加上一个井号，可以帮助 Bar Camp 的其他人从他们的推特流中挑出 Bar Camp 这个词，

sentences.en: and encourages all the other Bar Camp participants to use the word Bar Camp in their tweets.
sentences.zh: 并鼓励所有其他 Bar Camp 参与者在他们的推文中也使用 Bar Camp 这个词。

sentences.en: So now everyone who's interested in Bar Camp can search for that term and join the conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以现在所有对 Bar Camp 感兴趣的人都可以搜索这个词并加入对话了。

sentences.en: Now let's hope I never have to use the word Bar Camp again.
sentences.zh: 现在希望我永远不用再用 Bar Camp 这个词了。

sentences.en: So some people got on board and agreed to use the pound sign, but most were like, okay, you go do that.
sentences.zh: 所以有些人加入了并同意使用井号，但大多数人觉得，好吧，你去做吧。

sentences.en: The pound symbol had already pervaded other corners of the web.
sentences.zh: 井号已经渗透到了网络的其他角落。

sentences.en: Internet Relay Chat, aka IRC, used the pound sign to represent chat rooms or conversation channels.
sentences.zh: 互联网中继聊天，也就是 IRC，用井号来代表聊天室或对话频道。

sentences.en: There was another social network at the time called JICU that also had these channels.
sentences.zh: 当时还有另一个名为 JICU 的社交网络也有这些频道。

sentences.en: So there was other stuff that came before me.
sentences.zh: 所以在我之前还有其他东西。

sentences.en: But Chris was using bunches of pound signs throughout his tweets.
sentences.zh: 但克里斯在他的推文中到处都在使用一堆井号。

sentences.en: I was putting pound symbols in front of my words, and people were like, I don't understand what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 我把井号放在我的词前面，人们说，我不明白你在做什么。

sentences.en: You're putting all this strange punctuation in front of your stuff, and it looks dumb.
sentences.zh: 你在你的东西前面加上所有这些奇怪的标点符号，看起来很蠢。

sentences.en: But the true believers stood by the sign.
sentences.zh: 但真正的信徒们坚持使用这个符号。

sentences.en: One Twitter user called it a hash tag, because hash is the British name for the sign, and these were being used as category tags.
sentences.zh: 一个推特用户称之为 hash tag，因为 hash 是英国人对这个符号的称呼，而这些符号当时正被用作分类标签。

sentences.en: And then the hash and the tag got conjoined into one word.
sentences.zh: 然后 hash 和 tag 就合并成了一个词。

sentences.en: Chris actually brought the hashtag idea to Twitter headquarters directly, but they thought it would never catch on.
sentences.zh: 克里斯实际上直接把标签的想法带到了推特总部，但他们认为这永远不会流行起来。

sentences.en: It looked clunky.
sentences.zh: 它看起来很笨拙。

sentences.en: Then, a few months later, in October of 2007, the purpose of the hashtag was fully realized.
sentences.zh: 然后，几个月后，在2007年10月，标签的用途得到了充分的体现。

sentences.en: A friend of mine was down in San Diego.
sentences.zh: 我的一个朋友在圣地亚哥。

sentences.en: His name is Nate Ritter.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫内特·里特。

sentences.en: And he was using Twitter, basically pulling all this stuff together around these fires that were going on in San Diego.
sentences.zh: 他在使用推特，基本上把所有这些围绕着圣地亚哥正在发生的火灾的信息整合在一起。

sentences.en: Wildfires were raging around San Diego, and residents were tracking the spread through Nate Ritter's tweets.
sentences.zh: 野火在圣地亚哥周围肆虐，居民们通过内特·里特的推文追踪火势蔓延情况。

sentences.en: But, he was prefixing all of his tweets with San, space, Diego, space, fire.
sentences.zh: 但是，他在他所有的推文前面都加上了圣、地亚哥、火。

sentences.en: So, Chris told Nate that he should switch to hashtag San Diego fire, all one word, and then other users would imitate him.
sentences.zh: 所以，克里斯告诉内特，他应该改用 hashtag 圣地亚哥火灾，全部连成一个词，然后其他用户就会模仿他。

sentences.en: And it worked.
sentences.zh: 这奏效了。

sentences.en: People trying to find out about the fire knew exactly where to look on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 试图了解火灾情况的人确切地知道在推特上去哪里寻找。

sentences.en: And this was the moment where everyone went, oh, that's what these signs are for.
sentences.zh: 这就是每个人都发出“哦，原来这些符号是这个用途”的那一刻。

sentences.en: Now, to clarify, hashtags weren't a thing that Twitter planned on.
sentences.zh: 现在澄清一下，标签并不是推特计划中的东西。

sentences.en: And they kind of dragged their feet on incorporating it.
sentences.zh: 他们对纳入这个功能有点拖延。

sentences.en: We kept thinking, there must be a better way to organize all this information that's flowing through Twitter.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在想，一定有一种更好的方法来组织流经推特的这些信息。

sentences.en: We kept looking for it.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在寻找它。

sentences.en: We never really found it.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没有真正找到过。

sentences.en: But the hashtag, in retrospect, was just this obvious tool.
sentences.zh: 但事后看来，标签只是这个显而易见的工具。

sentences.en: Andy Loric, then an employee at Twitter, officially brought in the hashtag.
sentences.zh: 安迪·洛里克，当时推特的一名员工，正式引入了标签。

sentences.en: The users brought in the hashtag.
sentences.zh: 是用户引入了标签。

sentences.en: All I did was link the hashtag to Twitter search.
sentences.zh: 我所做的只是把标签链接到推特搜索。

sentences.en: One line of code took me about 15 seconds.
sentences.zh: 一行代码花了我大约15秒钟。

sentences.en: Didn't really ask anybody.
sentences.zh: 也没有真的问任何人。

sentences.en: That one line of code meant that when you clicked on a word with a hashtag in front of it, you'd see a page with all the other tweets that also contained that hashtagged word.
sentences.zh: 那一行代码意味着，当你点击一个前面带有标签的词时，你会看到一个页面，上面有包含该带标签词的所有其他推文。

sentences.en: And basically, this helped you round up everyone who was talking about a specific topic.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这帮你汇集了所有讨论特定话题的人。

sentences.en: And now the hashtag is a tool used in advertisements, social movements, music videos, memes, TV shows.
sentences.zh: 现在，标签已成为广告、社会运动、音乐视频、模因、电视节目中使用的工具。

sentences.en: And in conversation.
sentences.zh: 还有对话中。

sentences.en: Hashtag sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时候加个标签。

sentences.en: Hey, Justin, what's up?
sentences.zh: 嘿，贾斯汀，怎么了？

sentences.en: Not much, Jimmy.
sentences.zh: 没什么，吉米。

sentences.en: Hashtag chillin'.
sentences.zh: 标签：闲逛中。

sentences.en: What's up with you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: It's been busy working.
sentences.zh: 最近忙着工作。

sentences.en: Hashtag rise and grind.
sentences.zh: 标签：努力奋斗。

sentences.en: Hashtag is it Friday yet?
sentences.zh: 标签：今天是周五吗？

sentences.en: Even Chris acknowledges how irritating this is.
sentences.zh: 甚至连克里斯也承认这有多烦人。

sentences.en: Do you say it out loud?
sentences.zh: 你会大声说出来吗？

sentences.en: Mostly when I'm being annoying or ironic.
sentences.zh: 主要是在我很烦人或带有讽刺意味的时候。

sentences.en: But I'm coming to sort of accept that that's the phrase.
sentences.zh: 但我开始有点接受这就是这种说法了。

sentences.en: It's getting to the point where the hashtag is erasing the symbol's other uses.
sentences.zh: 现在的情况是，标签正在抹去这个符号的其他用途。

sentences.en: A friend of mine actually sent me a tweet the other day saying that his delivery guy showed up and was looking for hashtag 2A.
sentences.zh: 我的一个朋友前几天确实给我发了一条推特，说他的送货员出现并正在寻找标签 2A。

sentences.en: Though I'd hope that most people who make deliveries for a living, hashtag SMH, would know it more as a number sign.
sentences.zh: 虽然我希望大多数以送货为生的人，标签：无语，会更多地把它当作数字符号来认识。

sentences.en: In the States, it's usually called the number sign or the pound sign.
sentences.zh: 在美国，它通常被称为数字符号或磅符号。

sentences.en: In the UK, it's often called a hash mark.
sentences.zh: 在英国，它通常被称为 hash mark。

sentences.en: I think more because of the way it looks than anything else.
sentences.zh: 我想这更多是因为它的外观而不是别的什么。

sentences.en: This is Keith Houston.
sentences.zh: 这是基思·休斯顿。

sentences.en: He's the author of a book called Shady Characters, The Secret Life of Punctuation, Symbols, and Other Typographical Marks.
sentences.zh: 他是《隐秘的符号：标点、符号和其他排版标记的秘密生活》一书的作者。

sentences.en: It's got a whole chapter on this symbol.
sentences.zh: 里面有一整章专门讲这个符号。

sentences.en: And it has a lot of other random uses as well.
sentences.zh: 它还有很多其他随机的用途。

sentences.en: It's used in chess to represent a move that results in checkmate.
sentences.zh: 它在国际象棋中用于表示导致将死的走法。

sentences.en: In proofreading, if you see a hash symbol, this means a space should be inserted here.
sentences.zh: 在校对中，如果你看到一个 hash 符号，这意味着这里应该插入一个空格。

sentences.en: It's used on Swedish maps to mean a lumber yard.
sentences.zh: 它在瑞典地图上用于表示木材厂。

sentences.en: Hash.
sentences.zh: 井号。

sentences.en: Pound.
sentences.zh: 磅号。

sentences.en: Number sign.
sentences.zh: 数字符号。

sentences.en: Lumber yard.
sentences.zh: 木材厂。

sentences.en: Whatever you want to call it.
sentences.zh: 随便你怎么叫它。

sentences.en: However you want to use it.
sentences.zh: 随便你想怎么用它。

sentences.en: The symbol traces back to ancient Rome.
sentences.zh: 这个符号可以追溯到古罗马。

sentences.en: So in Rome, the term Libra pondo meant a pound in weight.
sentences.zh: 所以在罗马，术语 Libra pondo 意为一磅重量。

sentences.en: So the word Libra, like the constellation, means scales or balances.
sentences.zh: 所以词 Libra，就像星座一样，意思是秤或天平。

sentences.en: And pondo comes from the verb pendere, which means to weigh.
sentences.zh: 而 pondo 来自动词 pendere，意思是称重。

sentences.en: Libra pondo.
sentences.zh: 磅重。

sentences.en: And these two names were interchangeable.
sentences.zh: 这两个名字是可以互换的。

sentences.en: So Romans referred to this weight measurement as a Libra or a pondo.
sentences.zh: 所以罗马人把这种重量测量称为 Libra 或 pondo。

sentences.en: So the word Libra was often abbreviated as LB.
sentences.zh: 因此单词 Libra 通常缩写为 LB。

sentences.en: Lowercase l, lowercase b, which of course we still use.
sentences.zh: 小写 l，小写 b，我们当然现在还在用。

sentences.en: So if you see 5LB, you mean 5 Libra or 5 pounds in the Latin sense.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你看到 5LB，你的意思是 5 Libra 或拉丁意义上的 5 磅。

sentences.en: This is also why British currency, the pound, is represented by a stylized L for Libra.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么英国货币“磅”用代表 Libra 的风格化 L 来表示。

sentences.en: So the abbreviation LB becomes a thing.
sentences.zh: 于是缩写 LB 出现了。

sentences.en: And oftentimes it was drawn with a little bar across the tops of both letters,
sentences.zh: 而且通常在两个字母的顶部画一个小横杠，

sentences.en: just to show that the L and the B were connected.
sentences.zh: 只是为了表明 L 和 B 是连在一起的。

sentences.en: Scribes, or writers, got a bit careless.
sentences.zh: 抄写员，或者说作家，变得有点粗心。

sentences.en: So they'd write faster and faster and faster.
sentences.zh: 所以他们写得越来越快。

sentences.en: So you join the L to the B, and then maybe the pen doesn't leave the paper
sentences.zh: 所以你把 L 和 B 连起来，然后可能笔没有离开纸

sentences.en: before it does the little bar across the top.
sentences.zh: 就在顶部画了那个小横杠。

sentences.en: And so this seems to have given rise to the pound symbol.
sentences.zh: 这似乎催生了磅符号。

sentences.en: Or hash mark.
sentences.zh: 或者 hash mark。

sentences.en: Or lumber yard.
sentences.zh: 或者木材厂。

sentences.en: Over time, the symbol's meaning started to bifurcate.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这个符号的含义开始分叉。

sentences.en: It was used like LB for the unit pound,
sentences.zh: 它像 LB 一样用于单位磅，

sentences.en: and it also started to be used as a number sign.
sentences.zh: 它也开始被用作数字符号。

sentences.en: It had a lot of various uses.
sentences.zh: 它有很多各种各样的用途。

sentences.en: But it was important enough to wind up on typewriter keyboards,
sentences.zh: 但它足够重要，最终登上了打字机键盘，

sentences.en: which is kind of the key thing.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是关键所在。

sentences.en: It's the thing that a symbol had to do in order to survive.
sentences.zh: 这是符号为了生存必须做的事情。

sentences.en: Because symbols that didn't make it onto the typewriter keyboard got pretty unpopular.
sentences.zh: 因为没有进入打字机键盘的符号变得很不受欢迎。

sentences.en: Like the Interobang, or the Pilgrim, or the Manicule.
sentences.zh: 比如问叹号、朝圣者符号或手形符号。

sentences.en: It's poor things.
sentences.zh: 真是可怜的东西。

sentences.en: Fast forward to 1963.
sentences.zh: 快进到1963年。

sentences.en: The invention of the touch-tone telephone.
sentences.zh: 按键式电话的发明。

sentences.en: Hi, this is the Bell System's new touch-tone dialing.
sentences.zh: 嗨，这是贝尔系统的新按键式拨号。

sentences.en: The touch-tone phone used buttons instead of a rotary wheel.
sentences.zh: 按键式电话使用按钮而不是旋转盘。

sentences.en: So unlike previous phones,
sentences.zh: 因此与以前的电话不同，

sentences.en: the numbers didn't have to be arranged in a circle on the dial anymore.
sentences.zh: 数字不再需要在拨号盘上排成一个圆形。

sentences.en: Bell Laboratories, a research subsidiary of AT&T,
sentences.zh: 贝尔实验室，AT&T 的一个研究子公司，

sentences.en: experimented with a few different designs for the telephone keypad.
sentences.zh: 尝试了电话键盘的一些不同设计。

sentences.en: They tried arranging the numbers in two rows of five,
sentences.zh: 他们尝试将数字排列成两行，每行五个，

sentences.en: in a circle, in a cross, in a step pattern.
sentences.zh: 排成圆形、十字形、阶梯形。

sentences.en: But they ended up arranging the numbers one through nine
sentences.zh: 但他们最终还是把 1 到 9 的数字排列好了

sentences.en: in a three-by-three grid.
sentences.zh: 在三乘三的网格中。

sentences.en: And they put zero alone in the bottom center.
sentences.zh: 他们把数字零单独放在底部正中央。

sentences.en: Years later, in 1968, they figured,
sentences.zh: 多年后的1968年，他们想出了一个主意：

sentences.en: why not add keys to either side of the zero?
sentences.zh: 为什么不在零的两边加上按键呢？

sentences.en: This would make the keypad into a nice, even rectangle.
sentences.zh: 这样就能把键盘变成一个整齐的偶数矩形。

sentences.en: And give users a few more options on the phone menu.
sentences.zh: 还能给电话菜单上的用户多提供几个选项。

sentences.en: To repeat these options, press the star key.
sentences.zh: 要重复这些选项，请按星号键。

sentences.en: Because unlike rotary phones,
sentences.zh: 因为与转盘电话不同，

sentences.en: touch-tone phones allow you to continue to dial
sentences.zh: 按键式电话允许你在

sentences.en: after the connection has been made.
sentences.zh: 接通后继续拨号。

sentences.en: So you could punch in extensions and navigate automated menus.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以输入分机号并浏览自动菜单。

sentences.en: For account information, press 1.
sentences.zh: 如需账户信息，请按1。

sentences.en: For all other questions, press 2.
sentences.zh: 如需其他所有问题，请按2。

sentences.en: Originally, Bell Labs wanted pretty shapes on the two extra buttons.
sentences.zh: 最初，贝尔实验室想在两个额外的按键上使用漂亮的形状。

sentences.en: They had made prototype phones that had a five-pointed star
sentences.zh: 他们制作过原型电话，上面有一个五角星

sentences.en: and a diamond on either side of the zero.
sentences.zh: 以及零两侧的菱形。

sentences.en: But an engineer named Doug Kerr
sentences.zh: 但有个名叫道格·克尔的工程师

sentences.en: would have none of this diamond and five-point star business.
sentences.zh: 对这种菱形和五角星的把戏完全不买账。

sentences.en: Because by that time, a new thing had come into the picture,
sentences.zh: 因为当时出现了一种新情况，

sentences.en: the possibility of customers dialing directly from their phones
sentences.zh: 那就是客户可以直接从电话里拨号

sentences.en: into a computer for such things as checking bank balances
sentences.zh: 接入电脑，用来查询银行余额

sentences.en: or validating their credit cards or what have you.
sentences.zh: 或者验证信用卡之类的用途。

sentences.en: Doug Kerr wanted to make sure that the two new symbols
sentences.zh: 道格·克尔想要确保这两个新符号

sentences.en: would be ones a computer could recognize,
sentences.zh: 是电脑能够识别的符号，

sentences.en: ones that appear on a keyboard
sentences.zh: 是键盘上会出现的符号，

sentences.en: and were part of the computer's vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 并且是电脑词汇的一部分。

sentences.en: So there would be no uncertainty
sentences.zh: 这样就不会产生任何不确定性，

sentences.en: about how a certain button would be recorded
sentences.zh: 关于某个按键将如何被记录

sentences.en: in the data that went into the computer.
sentences.zh: 在输入电脑的数据中。

sentences.en: Bell Labs was pretty set on their star and diamond idea.
sentences.zh: 贝尔实验室非常坚持他们的星号和菱形方案。

sentences.en: So the compromise was an asterisk for the star
sentences.zh: 所以妥协的方案是用星号代替星星

sentences.en: and a pound for the diamond
sentences.zh: 用井号代替菱形

sentences.en: because, you know, the center kind of looked diamond-like, I guess.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，中间看起来有点像菱形，我猜吧。

sentences.en: And for a second, AT&T was like,
sentences.zh: 而且有一会儿，AT&T觉得：

sentences.en: can we at least call it a diamond?
sentences.zh: 我们至少能把它叫作菱形吗？

sentences.en: There's no reasonable reason to call that symbol diamond.
sentences.zh: 没有任何合理的理由把那个符号叫作菱形。

sentences.en: It's not a diamond at all.
sentences.zh: 它一点也不像菱形。

sentences.en: AT&T didn't know what to call this button in their manuals,
sentences.zh: AT&T不知道在手册里该怎么称呼这个按键，

sentences.en: and this led to the creation of what some people,
sentences.zh: 这催生了某些人创造的一个词，

sentences.en: including Keith Houston,
sentences.zh: 包括基思·休斯顿在内，

sentences.en: consider the symbol's official name.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是该符号的官方名称。

sentences.en: The Octothorpe.
sentences.zh: 八角符（Octothorpe）。

sentences.en: The Octothorpe.
sentences.zh: 八角符。

sentences.en: One day I was out with my engineering partner
sentences.zh: 有一天我和我的工程搭档外出，

sentences.en: and we got to talking about it
sentences.zh: 我们聊起了这个，

sentences.en: and thought maybe we should come up with a new name.
sentences.zh: 并觉得或许我们该想个新名字。

sentences.en: This is Loren Asplund.
sentences.zh: 这是洛伦·阿斯普伦德。

sentences.en: He worked in marketing for AT&T during the time.
sentences.zh: 他当时在AT&T的营销部门工作。

sentences.en: He and his engineering partner looked at the symbol
sentences.zh: 他和他的工程搭档看着这个符号，

sentences.en: and saw that it had eight lines sticking out of it.
sentences.zh: 发现它有八条线伸出来。

sentences.en: So we'll put the word Octo in there
sentences.zh: 所以我们在里面加上了“Octo”这个词，

sentences.en: and then just out of thin air,
sentences.zh: 然后凭空地，

sentences.en: we just said, well, we'll put the word Therp,
sentences.zh: 我们只是说，好吧，我们把“Therp”这个词，

sentences.en: T-H-E-R-P, in there too
sentences.zh: T-H-E-R-P，也加进去

sentences.en: because that sounds kind of Greek-ish
sentences.zh: 因为听起来有点希腊风味，

sentences.en: and gave it some stature.
sentences.zh: 而且显得有些分量。

sentences.en: They called it an Octothorpe,
sentences.zh: 他们把它叫作Octothorpe，

sentences.en: but that morphed into Octothorpe,
sentences.zh: 但后来演变成了Octothorpe（拼写微调），

sentences.en: which rumor has it came about
sentences.zh: 有传言说它的出现

sentences.en: because someone at Bell Labs changed the name
sentences.zh: 是因为贝尔实验室有人改了名字，

sentences.en: to turn it into a tribute to Olympic athlete Jim Thorpe,
sentences.zh: 把它变成对奥运会运动员吉姆·索普的致敬，

sentences.en: but no one really knows.
sentences.zh: 但没有人真正知道真相。

sentences.en: Gee, is it proper to spell it Octothorpe rather than Therp?
sentences.zh: 天哪，拼成Octothorpe而不是Therp才对吗？

sentences.en: There is no proper.
sentences.zh: 没有什么对不对的。

sentences.en: Doug calls it an Octothorpe.
sentences.zh: 道格叫它Octothorpe。

sentences.en: Loren calls it an Octothorpe,
sentences.zh: 洛伦叫它Octothorpe，

sentences.en: but Octothorpe seems to have the most widespread use,
sentences.zh: 但Octothorpe似乎使用得最为广泛，

sentences.en: though its use is not widely spread.
sentences.zh: 尽管它的使用并没有广泛传开。

sentences.en: And originally the only reason Octothorpe ever caught on within Bell Labs
sentences.zh: 最初Octothorpe能在贝尔实验室流行起来的唯一原因

sentences.en: was because engineers thought it was a funny joke.
sentences.zh: 是因为工程师们觉得这是一个滑稽的笑话。

sentences.en: The manufacturer, Western Electric, totally hated that name
sentences.zh: 制造商西方电气公司非常讨厌这个名字，

sentences.en: and pretty much killed it in the 70s.
sentences.zh: 并在70年代几乎把它给废用了。

sentences.en: But today, for a lot of type aficionados,
sentences.zh: 但今天，对于许多字体爱好者来说，

sentences.en: Octothorpe is the sign's real name.
sentences.zh: Octothorpe才是这个符号真正的名字。

sentences.en: In typographic books, Octothorpe is the name used,
sentences.zh: 在字体排印学书籍中，使用的名字就是Octothorpe，

sentences.en: you might think of it as a technical term.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它当成一个专业术语。

sentences.en: Typographic nerds like Keith love it
sentences.zh: 像基思这样的字体排印极客非常喜欢它，

sentences.en: because it feels the most neutral and official.
sentences.zh: 因为它感觉最中立、最官方。

sentences.en: But in choosing this symbol, whatever it's called,
sentences.zh: 但在选择这个符号时，无论它叫什么名字，

sentences.en: Doug Kerr and the other Bell Labs engineers
sentences.zh: 道格·克尔和其他贝尔实验室的工程师

sentences.en: really understood that we would be using telephones
sentences.zh: 确实意识到我们将会使用电话

sentences.en: to communicate with computers.
sentences.zh: 来与计算机进行通信。

sentences.en: And this is exactly the same reason why Chris Messina
sentences.zh: 这与克里斯·梅西纳

sentences.en: chose to use this symbol back in that tweet in 2007.
sentences.zh: 在2007年的那条推文中选择使用这个符号的原因完全相同。

sentences.en: At the time, we had Blackberries, we had Nokia phones,
sentences.zh: 当时，我们有黑莓手机，我们有诺基亚手机，

sentences.en: and these are hardware-based keyboards.
sentences.zh: 这些都是基于硬件键盘的手机。

sentences.en: But we need something that works in the mobile world,
sentences.zh: 但我们需要能在移动世界中工作的东西，

sentences.en: and we need something that works over SMS
sentences.zh: 我们需要能在短信（SMS）上工作的东西，

sentences.en: because that's the way that I'm going to be publishing to Twitter.
sentences.zh: 因为那是我要发布到推特上的方式。

sentences.en: Which left Chris only two choices, the star or the pound.
sentences.zh: 这让克里斯只有两种选择，星号或井号。

sentences.en: The pound symbol, the Octothorpe, whatever.
sentences.zh: 井号符号、八角符，随便什么都行。

sentences.en: It's probably one of the most dense symbols.
sentences.zh: 它可能是信息最密集的符号之一。

sentences.en: And so when you're reading a sentence or you're reading a tweet,
sentences.zh: 所以当你阅读一个句子或阅读一条推文时，

sentences.en: it stands out.
sentences.zh: 它会脱颖而出。

sentences.en: And so you see hashtags on billboards, on the highway,
sentences.zh: 于是你在广告牌上、高速公路上看到井号，

sentences.en: on promotional materials, on other social media platforms,
sentences.zh: 在宣传材料上、在其他社交媒体平台上，

sentences.en: on protest signs, in your annoying friends' conversations.
sentences.zh: 在抗议标语上，在你那些讨厌的朋友的对话中都能看到。

sentences.en: I just saw my dentiSt.
sentences.zh: 我刚看了牙医。

sentences.en: Hashtag bling.
sentences.zh: 话题：亮晶晶。

sentences.en: Hashtag dental care.
sentences.zh: 话题：牙齿护理。

sentences.en: Hashtag cavity free.
sentences.zh: 话题：没有蛀牙。

sentences.en: Hashtag that's how we do.
sentences.zh: 话题：我们就是这么做的。

sentences.en: And this is all probably going to sound so dated in, like, five years
sentences.zh: 这一切在大概五年后听起来

sentences.en: or two years or maybe a few months.
sentences.zh: 或者两年后，或者也许几个月后，都可能会显得过时。

sentences.en: Hearing hashtag out loud is going to sound like someone reading a telegram.
sentences.zh: 大声读出“话题”（hashtag）听起来就像有人在读电报。

sentences.en: Mr. Gower cabled, you need cash.
sentences.zh: 高尔先生发电报称，你需要现金。

sentences.en: Stop.
sentences.zh: 句号。

sentences.en: My office instructed to advance you up to $25,000.
sentences.zh: 我办公室指示向你预支至多25,000美元。

sentences.en: Stop.
sentences.zh: 句号。

sentences.en: Hee-haw and Merry Christmas, Sam Wainwright.
sentences.zh: 呼哈，圣诞快乐，萨姆·温赖特。

sentences.en: In a telegram, as on Twitter,
sentences.zh: 在电报中，正如在推特上一样，

sentences.en: our speech changed to accommodate the machines.
sentences.zh: 我们的语言发生了改变以适应机器。

sentences.en: The hashtag is a way of changing our language
sentences.zh: 话题符号是一种改变我们语言的方式，

sentences.en: to be more computer-friendly.
sentences.zh: 使其对计算机更友好。

sentences.en: And what we're needing to do is actually invert the paradigm
sentences.zh: 而我们需要做的是颠覆这种范式，

sentences.en: where the computers become more friendly to humans.
sentences.zh: 让计算机变得对人类更友好。

sentences.en: So we're probably not going to be using hashtags
sentences.zh: 所以我们可能不会永远使用

sentences.en: the way Twitter uses hashtags forever.
sentences.zh: 推特使用话题的那种方式。

sentences.en: But this won't mean the end of the symbol itself.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着这个符号本身的终结。

sentences.en: It started out on paper,
sentences.zh: 它最初诞生于纸面上，

sentences.en: but then it leaped to typewriters, computers, and phones,
sentences.zh: 但随后它跃入了打字机、电脑和电话中，

sentences.en: and it seems like it's probably going to stick around.
sentences.zh: 而且它看起来可能会一直存在下去。

sentences.en: Whatever we decide to call it.
sentences.zh: 无论我们决定叫它什么。

sentences.en: Hashtag Octothorpe.
sentences.zh: 话题：八角符。

sentences.en: Hashtag Octotherp.
sentences.zh: 话题：八角符（变体）。

sentences.en: Hashtag Pound.
sentences.zh: 话题：井号。

sentences.en: Hashtag Number Sign.
sentences.zh: 话题：数字符号。

sentences.en: Hashtag Lumberyard.
sentences.zh: 话题：木材厂。

sentences.en: Hashtag Tic-Tac-Toe.
sentences.zh: 话题：井字棋。

sentences.en: Hashtag Musical Sharp if you're really lazy.
sentences.zh: 如果你真的很懒，也可以叫话题：升号。

sentences.en: Stop.
sentences.zh: 完毕。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Avery Truffleman
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由埃弗里·特鲁夫曼制作

sentences.en: with Sam Greenspan, Katie Mingle, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 合作者有萨姆·格林斯潘、凯蒂·明格，以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 Local Public Radio KALW in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7地方公共广播电台KALW的一个项目

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 制作于ArcSign的办公室里，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 这是一家位于美丽的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心的建筑与室内设计公司。

sentences.en: I also invented the caps lock key.
sentences.zh: 我还发明了大写锁定键。

sentences.en: People curse me every day when they have it engaged
sentences.zh: 人们每天都在大写锁定开启时咒骂它

sentences.en: and wish it was disengaged.
sentences.zh: 并希望它没开启。

sentences.en: You can find the show and hang out with other people
sentences.zh: 你可以在脸书上找到这个节目并与其他

sentences.en: who like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 喜欢这个节目的听众交流。

sentences.en: All of the 99PI producers use Twitter,
sentences.zh: 所有99PI的制作人都在使用推特，

sentences.en: so search for 99% Invisible on Twitter and you will find us.
sentences.zh: 所以在推特上搜索99% Invisible就能找到我们。

sentences.en: But you're always welcome at our place at 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 不过随时欢迎你访问我们的网站99PI.org。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: 电台乌托邦（Radiotopia）。
